features: Reliable Membrane Keyboard – High-quality membrane switches deliver smooth, quiet and responsive typing with a key life of up to 10 million keystrokes, making it ideal for office work, business, education and everyday computing.

Laser-Etched Durable Keys – Premium laser-etched key characters resist fading even after prolonged usage, ensuring long-lasting readability and consistent typing performance for professionals and students.
Plug & Play USB Connectivity – USB 2.0 interface offers instant connectivity without driver installation. Compatible with Windows XP, Vista, Windows 7, Windows 8 and Windows 10 desktops and laptops.

Designed for Comfortable Typing – Full-size 104-key layout with ergonomic palm rest, dedicated multimedia function keys, strong adjustable legs and integrated Rupee (₹) symbol key for improved productivity.

Built for Everyday Durability – Spill-resistant construction helps protect against accidental liquid spills, while the durable ABS body and stable adjustable legs ensure reliable long-term performance.

Perfect for Office & Home Use – Suitable for desktop computers, laptops, workstations, billing counters, educational institutions, banking, accounting, retail stores and everyday professional applications.
